Your onboarding journey

This guide is the employee's onboarding map and progress record. It shows what should happen, who owns it, when it is due and where to find the detailed instructions. HR owns the guide; HR and the supervisor update it jointly, and the employee can view its progress.

How to update a status: click the status field dropdown on any milestone and choose 🔴 Not Started, 🟡 In Progress, 🟢 Completed or ⚪ Not Applicable.

Office attendance during probation

During the three-month probation period, employees will ordinarily report physically to the office each working day to support orientation, supervision and integration. Any alternative working arrangement must receive prior written approval in accordance with the applicable company policy.

fields.label: End of Probation Milestones
fields.options: Onboarding Guide Milestone
Detailed resources: Probation Review Process and Templates; ICL Offboarding Checklist.

Completion standard: Onboarding closes after the probation outcome has been communicated and recorded. For Outcome A, the confirmation and benefits documents must be issued. For Outcome B, the seven-day notice must be communicated and the ICL Offboarding Checklist started. Any remaining onboarding actions must be resolved or formally transferred.
